title: The Old Soldier's Grave
text: A cairn by the road with a rusted helm on top, and words scratched deep into the rock beneath it: FOR THE ONE WHO PUT THE SWORD DOWN AND PICKED IT UP AGAIN. The stones are clean of moss. Someone has been tending it.

options.label: The one it names kneels at the cairn, feeling the words were carved for them.

outcomes.text: They stand up with an old soldier's patience settled in them, slow and sure.
They rise older, with grey in their hair that was not there before. The soldier gave what he had but took something in return.

options.label: Pass by without stopping. The dead have had their due.

outcomes.text: The helm turns to watch you go. Every hand on a sword feels heavier for not having stopped.
The helm turns to watch you go, then nods once. You march straighter for the old soldier's approval.

options.label: The Soldier lays their sword on the cairn, then takes it up again as the words ask.

outcomes.text: The helm nods. The blade comes away from the cairn truer than it was laid down.
